title: The JA Boxing 1.0.8 contract on place-content-roles/3 holds nothing on Road to live: every label rule at 0, every located slot judged right, the Typography page demo-only, and the Private Training phone in its own slot
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/content-coverage.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/content-coverage.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: Release 1.0.8 of ja-boxing judged against the shipped contracts has labelHolds false, no failing label rule, judgeHolds false, no wrong-group or mismatch verdict, and fitState ready.
The 1.0.8 content map is place-content-roles/3, entity article-17 carries demoOnly true, and slot module-177.14 is contact.phone.
A text block printed from a label slot and a phone slot with no letter matches both slots by composite instead of leaving the number as a hole.
evidence: On a clean install of the 1.0.8 installer the audit left the Private Training phone line as an unknown-source hole (R9 = 1) because a phone-only slot never took part in composite matching.
fence: The 1.0.8 contract under packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-boxing/j6/1.0.8 commits label rules all at 0 and a judged label judge; loadContract puts a figure-only text slot of 7 or more digits into the composite list.

tests: label rules group: the released JA Boxing 1.0.8 contract (role vocabulary 3) holds nothing: every rule at 0, every located slot judged right, its style-guide page demo-only
a block made of a label slot and a phone slot is that pair: a figure slot with no letter still counts
